notes.title: 1 Week Launch Update
notes.notes: [p]What a week!  A huge THANK YOU to everyone who's played, shared feedback, and supported Diner Bros so far.  After a flurry of fixes/updates, I think I've gotten the most urgent fixes out and can now [b]look forward to releasing proper content updates[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback over the last week has absolutely helped improve the Diner Bros experience:[/p][list][*][p]Controls and input fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Camera view change[/p][/*][*][p]Bug squashing[/p][/*][/list][p]Please keep sharing your feedback!  It is [i]incredibly[/i] helpful.[/p][p][/p][h3]Launch Discount Ends Tomorrow![/h3][p]Today's the last day to grab DB2 at the discounted price!  Don't miss it![/p][p][/p][h3]Contest Reminder[/h3][p]Don't forget to enter our fridge magnet contest!  You have 1 more day to enter.  All you have to do to enter is post a screenshot on the Discord. So easy!  (NA only)[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Azb8Ee3gSr"]https://discord.gg/Azb8Ee3gSr[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45441425/4f8f822a85e409f022b4097df820441f3e52e178.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update v1.09: Corners and Smacking
notes.notes: [p]Sorry for all these updates, I think I can slow down after this one![/p][p][/p][h2]Update v1.09[/h2][list][*][p]Accessing corner equipment via controllers is now possible again[/p][/*][*][p]Fried chicken is now combinable on counter even after multi-hold is unlocked (and without a plate)[/p][/*][*][p]When customers are emoting (after finishing their meal) they can be interrupted with a smack[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Servers should never be texting anymore[/p][/*][*][p]I've removed all risky music from the Streamer Friendly music pool[/p][/*][*][p]Improved table moving in build mode[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update v1.08: More control changes
notes.notes: [p]This latest update aims to return the player controls back to the style of Diner Bros 1[/p][p][/p][h3]Update v1.08[/h3][list][*][p]Additional changes to equipment hitboxes and player aim/movement controls[/p][/*][*][p]The high camera angle is now the default view[/p][list][*][p]The intent is for improved clarity when aiming at equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]If you like the old view, you can get it back by toggling "Alternate Camera Angle" in the options[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Difficulty:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced chance of extra customer spawns[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced chance of NPC_Kid ordering large quantities of chicken[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced chance of NPC_Kid spawning[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]2 Player mode: Server will now show up earlier: Usually a few days after the first restaurant expansion.  Previously, they would only show up after the second restaurant expansion[/p][/*][*][p]Daily Rating Letter: Slightly more negative weighting to customer wait times[/p][/*][*][p]"Bare Minimum Achievement": the requirement for 0 customers leaving has been removed[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update v1.04: A quick fix for a soft lock
notes.notes: [h3]Update v1.04[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed softlock caused by quitting immediately after buying an important item, going back to character select, and then restarting the same level (This is just a quick fix that won't fix soft-locked save files, it'll be best to just start a new save file - sorry!)[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Limit FPS" to the options (I would only use this if changing "Quality" does nothing) [/p][/*][*][p]Bumped up chance to see table in store [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed broken wall texture in Chicken Bros[/p][/*][/list]
